build_vgg_backbone: build a VGG backbone model with depth 11, 13, 16, or 19 for image feature extraction
create_vgg_layer: create a VGG layer with configurable conv blocks, dilation, and max pooling using make_vgg_layer
run_vgg_forward: run the VGG forward pass to extract feature maps from specified output stages
freeze_vgg_stages: freeze VGG backbone stages to prevent gradient updates during fine-tuning training
configure_vgg_classifier: configure a VGG backbone with a classifier head for multi-class image classification tasks
